name: Fungal Spores
summary: Around the Barrens' oases, Fungal Spores gather in swollen mushrooms. The waters quicken the life around them, and the Royal Apothecary Society seeks the spores for its alchemy.

sections.title: Vitality of the Oases
sections.body: The Barrens' oases bring unusual life to the dry plains. At the Forgotten Pools, the Lushwater Oasis, and the Stagnant Oasis, the water does more than ease thirst. It quickens and changes the plants and wildlife nearby. Mushrooms along the damp shores swell with spores, carrying the waters' concentrated power to spur growth. Naturalists study this change, while the Royal Apothecary Society gathers the mushrooms for its alchemy.

sections.title: Forsaken Alchemy
sections.body: Apothecaries abroad gather unusual local ingredients for their laboratories and colleagues. At the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim sends such reagents onward, including to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff. The spores are valuable for brewing potent chemical mixtures. Their natural properties have already been altered by the mysterious forces beneath Kalimdor's soil, making them useful to the Forsaken.

faq.answer: You find Fungal Spores in swollen mushrooms along the shores of the Barrens' major oases: the Forgotten Pools, the Lushwater Oasis, and the Stagnant Oasis.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken interested in them?
faq.answer: The oasis waters have altered the spores with vibrant life energy. Apothecary Helbrim uses them in potent mixtures for the Royal Apothecary Society and his colleague Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why do the mushrooms around the oases grow so large?
faq.answer: The waters at the Barrens' oases carry unusual life energy that changes nearby plants and animals. Fungi along the shores swell with altered spores.
Apothecary Helbrim, a Forsaken alchemist at the Crossroads in the Barrens, asks adventurers to gather spores for his research.

angles.text: As an undead, you know the Royal Apothecary Society values rare regional ingredients for its research. Kalimdor's altered fungi offer a different choice from Lordaeron's blighted plants.
As a herbalist, you can see how the life-giving waters of the Barrens' oases change the mushrooms growing nearby.
